name: google_maps_get_place_address
intent: Find the street address of a place in Google Maps
description: Search for a named place in Google Maps, open its details, scroll to reveal its address, and return the street address.
patterns: Tell me the street address of a place
What is the address of this place
Find a place's address in Maps
Look up an address for a place

inputs.name: place_name
inputs.description: The name of the place to search for

steps.intent: Scroll down through the place details to reveal the address
